Metadata.description: Free, open-source video meetings in your browser. No downloads.

Landing.headline: Video meetings in your browser.
Landing.subline: Free and open source. Nothing to install. Works on any device.
Landing.newHere: New here? Sign up with your Google or GitHub account. There’s no password to remember.
Landing.productShotLabel: A meeting in progress, with four people in a gallery and the meeting controls below
Landing.featuresTitle: Everything you expect from a meeting app

noDownloads.title: No downloads
noDownloads.body: Join from a link in any modern browser.

anyDevice.title: Works on phones and tablets
anyDevice.body: The same meeting on Windows, Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android.

screenShare.title: Screen sharing with sound
screenShare.body: Share a tab, a window or your whole screen.

safety.title: Waiting room and passcodes
safety.body: Hosts decide who gets in, and can remove anyone.

languages.title: Six languages
languages.body: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Japanese.

openSource.title: Free and open source
openSource.body: MIT-licensed, with no ads and no tracking.

Auth.signInSubtitle: No account yet? Continuing creates one.
Auth.signUpSubtitle: Free, with no password to remember. Use your Google or GitHub account.
Auth.failed: Sign-in was cancelled or didn't finish. Try again, or use the other option.
Auth.guestNote: Joining a meeting? You don't need an account. Just open the meeting link.

Join.label: Meeting ID or link
Join.placeholder: Enter a meeting ID or link
Join.error: Enter a 10-digit meeting ID or a meeting link.

Home.title: Home
Home.upcomingEmpty: No upcoming meetings. Scheduled meetings will show up here.
Home.laterTitle: Here’s the link to your meeting
Home.laterBody: Copy this link and send it to people you want to meet with. Save it so you can use it later, too.
Home.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Select it and copy it yourself.
Home.createFailed: Couldn’t create the meeting. Try again.

Pages.comingSoon: This page is on its way. It arrives with the features it belongs to.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

Meeting.endFailed: Couldn’t end the meeting. Try again.
Meeting.speaker: Speaker
Meeting.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Select it and copy it yourself.
Meeting.offline: You’re offline. FaceOn will reconnect when your connection is back.

left.endedByYou: You ended the meeting for everyone
left.removed: You were removed from the meeting
left.timeLimit: The meeting reached its time limit
left.connectionLost: You lost your connection to the meeting

notFound.title: Check your meeting ID
notFound.body: There’s no meeting with this ID. Check the link or ID, then try again.

ended.title: This meeting has ended
ended.body: Ask the host for a new link if you still need to meet.

signIn.title: Sign in to join
signIn.body: Sign in to your FaceOn account to join this meeting.

removed.title: You can’t rejoin this meeting
removed.body: The host removed you from this meeting.

PreJoin.waitingForHost: The host hasn’t started this meeting yet. You’ll join as soon as they do.
PreJoin.speakToTest: Say something to test your mic

errors.BAD_PASSCODE: That passcode isn’t right. Check the invite and try again.
errors.passcodeNeeded: This meeting has a passcode. Enter it to join.
errors.FULL: This meeting is full. Try again when someone leaves.
errors.NETWORK: Can’t reach FaceOn. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Enter your name, then try again.

microphone.blocked: Your browser is blocking your microphone. Allow it in the site settings (the icon in the address bar), then select Try again.
microphone.notFound: No microphone found. Connect one, then select Try again.
microphone.inUse: Your microphone is being used by another app. Close that app, then select Try again.
microphone.unavailableSetting: The microphone you chose isn’t available, so FaceOn is using another one.
microphone.unknown: Your microphone didn’t start. Select Try again.

camera.blocked: Your browser is blocking your camera. Allow it in the site settings (the icon in the address bar), then select Try again.
camera.notFound: No camera found. Connect one, then select Try again.
camera.inUse: Your camera is being used by another app. Close that app, then select Try again.
camera.unavailableSetting: The camera you chose isn’t available, so FaceOn is using another one.
camera.unknown: Your camera didn’t start. Select Try again.
